title: Snap to Objects (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Snap to Objects applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Snap to Objects (BtnSnapToObjects) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Snap To Objects toggles and restores the production state in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Snap To Objects command flips the add-in SnapManager state (measured via the production SnapToObjectsFeature.IsEnabled), a second invocation restores the original state, both invocations report execution, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.

snapshotNotice: Source scenario inventory only; ready/planned/blocked are planning states, not passing results. Office runner scripts and maintainer release evidence are not distributed with this source snapshot.
